info.title: Orbscan Open API
info.description: REST endpoints for Polymarket wallet activity, positions, transfers, transaction details, and L2 order book data.

get.description: Returns paginated buy, sell, and redeem activity for a wallet across every Polymarket market it has touched. Results are ordered newest-first and paginated with an opaque cursor.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to query.

parameters.name: marketIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated market IDs to filter to (e.g. `?marketIds=1,2`).

parameters.name: txHash
parameters.description: Filter to a single transaction hash. The value is automatically lower-cased before matching.

parameters.name: fromBlock
parameters.description: Only include activity at or after this block height.

parameters.name: toBlock
parameters.description: Only include activity at or before this block height.

parameters.name: fromTimestamp
parameters.description: Only include activity at or after this Unix timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: toTimestamp
parameters.description: Only include activity at or before this Unix timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the `nextCursor` (a base64 string) returned by the previous page to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100. Values above 100 are capped at 100.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64 cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns the trader's deposits and withdrawals, aggregated per transaction and ordered by time descending. Transfers from known reward / system addresses are excluded. Each record's `type` is either `deposit` (net inflow) or `withdrawal` (net outflow).

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Trader address, `0x` + 40 hex chars.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by transfer direction. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: fromTimestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive lower timestamp (Unix seconds).

parameters.name: toTimestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive upper timestamp (Unix seconds).

parameters.name: minDeposit
parameters.description: Minimum deposit amount to include. Withdrawals are always included regardless of this filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns the wallet's currently open positions — every outcome token held with a non-zero balance, along with pricing, PnL, and market metadata. Results are cursor-paginated.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to query.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

get.description: Returns the trader's closed positions — outcome tokens the wallet previously held in markets that have since resolved or positions it has since sold. Ordered by market / most recent trade descending. Positions here have `balance: "0"` and `closed: true`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Trader address, `0x` + 40 hex chars.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

parameters.name: marketIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated market IDs to filter to (e.g. `?marketIds=1,2`).

get.description: Returns the wallet's currently open combo (parlay) positions. Each combo position contains multiple legs, each representing a single market outcome. The overall position is valued based on all legs resolving correctly. Results are cursor-paginated.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to query.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

get.description: Returns a high-level portfolio summary for a wallet — the total mark-to-market value of all open positions, the USDC balance, and the combined portfolio value.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The wallet address to query.

get.description: Resolves the wallet address for a given signer / trader address. Returns the resolved wallet address (lowercase) or `null` when no wallet is found.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Signer / trader address, `0x` + 40 hex chars.

walletAddress.description: Resolved wallet address (lowercase), or `null` when no wallet is found.

get.description: Returns the trader's reward records (yield, maker/taker rebates, referral rewards, etc.), ordered by block time descending.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Trader address, `0x` + 40 hex chars.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated activity types (e.g. `?types=YIELD,MAKER_REBATE`). Case-insensitive. Supported values: `YIELD`, `MAKER_REBATE`, `TAKER_REBATE`, `REFERRAL_REWARD`, `REWARD`.

parameters.name: fromTimestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive lower timestamp (Unix seconds).

parameters.name: toTimestamp
parameters.description: Inclusive upper timestamp (Unix seconds).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Omit for the first page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or `null` when there are no more results.

get.description: Returns a decoded, human-readable summary of a single transaction plus every individual on-chain action (fills) it contains. Useful for inspecting exactly what happened inside one trade.

parameters.name: txHash
parameters.description: The transaction hash to decode.

200.description: Returns the decoded transaction. A well-formed hash that is not indexed returns `data: null`.

data.description: The decoded transaction, or `null` when the hash is well-formed but no indexed action matches it.

get.description: Returns Polymarket markets tagged as Crypto (Gamma `tag_id=21`) and their outcome tokens. Results are ordered by `marketId` in ascending order. Pass a returned `tokenId` to the order book events endpoint to reconstruct that token's book.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Exact Gamma market ID.

parameters.name: conditionId
parameters.description: Exact condition ID. It must start with `0x` followed by 64 hexadecimal characters. Input is case-insensitive and normalized to lowercase.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Return the market that contains this outcome token.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Orbscan availability status. `active` means Orbscan tracks the market as active. `closed` means it does not. This differs from the Gamma `closed` field. Input is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 100. Values outside 1 to 1,000 return `400`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response's `nextCursor`. Reuse it with the same filters.

items.question: Will the FDV of OpenSea's token be above $5b 1 week after launch?

400.description: An ID, `status`, or `limit` value is invalid.

get.description: Returns the stored L2 events needed to reconstruct an outcome token's order book. Provide at least one of `marketId`, `conditionId`, or `tokenId`. The API combines values in the same parameter with OR and different parameters with AND.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Market IDs to include. You can provide up to 20 as comma-separated values, repeated parameters, or both.

parameters.name: conditionId
parameters.description: Condition IDs to include. You can provide up to 20 as comma-separated values, repeated parameters, or both. Input is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Outcome token IDs to include. You can provide up to 50 as comma-separated values, repeated parameters, or both.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Event types to include: `book`, `price_change`, or both. The endpoint returns both when you omit this parameter.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on source time, Unix milliseconds.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on source time, Unix milliseconds. Must be greater than or equal to `from`.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort by source time. Defaults to `asc`. Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 1,000. Values outside 1 to 10,000 return `400`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the last item's `cursor` or the response's `nextCursor`. Keep the filters and `order` unchanged while paging one result set. To reconstruct a book, you can use a snapshot cursor to start a new ascending `price_change` query.

400.description: A filter, `eventType`, `order`, `limit`, timestamp, or time range is invalid; or no `marketId`, `conditionId`, or `tokenId` was supplied.

example.message: tokenId, marketId, or conditionId is required

get.description: Returns the earliest and latest source timestamps across the full stored order book table. These timestamps do not guarantee that every time or market is available through the events endpoint. The result is cached for 10 minutes.

bearerAuth.description: Paste your Orbscan API key here. The `Bearer` prefix is added automatically.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing or invalid.

Forbidden.description: The API key is valid but not allowed to use this resource.

TooManyRequests.description: The rate limit for your credential was exceeded.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Coverage is temporarily unavailable and no cached value can be returned.

tokenId.description: Outcome token ID, a positive uint256 as a decimal string (up to 78 digits).

marketId.description: Gamma market ID as a decimal string (up to 19 digits, signed 64-bit range).

status.description: Orbscan availability status. `active` means Orbscan tracks the market as active. Otherwise, the value is `closed`. This differs from the Gamma `closed` field.

cursor.description: Stable opaque boundary for this logical event; pass it back as the `cursor` query parameter.

tokenId.description: Outcome token whose independent book changed.

indexedTimestamp.description: Earliest ingestion time for the logical event, in Unix milliseconds. Subtract `timestamp` from this value to estimate total indexing latency.

side.description: Source side, normally `BUY` or `SELL`. Set only for `price_change`.

price.description: Price on a 0 to 1 scale. Set only for `price_change`.

sizeAfter.description: Remaining size after the update; `0` removes the level, any other value replaces the level size. Set only for `price_change`.

bids.description: Bid levels as `[price, size]` decimal-string pairs. Set only for `book`.

asks.description: Ask levels as `[price, size]` decimal-string pairs. Set only for `book`.

sourceHash.description: Hash supplied by Polymarket for integrity checks.

availableFrom.description: Earliest source timestamp across the order book table, Unix milliseconds.

availableTo.description: Latest source timestamp across the order book table, Unix milliseconds.

price.description: Price per share as a decimal (0–1). Multiply by 100 to get cents.

usdcSize.description: Gross USDC value of the action.

netSharesTransferred.description: Net shares transferred (positive = received, negative = sent).

positionSide.description: Which outcome the trade is on.

liquidityRole.description: MAKER or TAKER, or null for non-trade actions such as redeems.

txHash.description: Transaction hash (records are aggregated per transaction).

amount.description: Amount, absolute value of the net flow (USDC).

address.description: Counterparty address (sender for deposits, receiver for withdrawals). For bridged deposits this may be the zero address.

proxyWallet.description: The trader's proxy wallet (the reward recipient).

fromAddress.description: Address the reward was sent from.

tokenId.description: Polymarket outcome token ID involved in this fill.

size.description: Number of shares in this fill.

price.description: Price per share as a decimal (0–1).

outcomeIndex.description: Outcome index the leg is on.

outcome.description: Outcome label for the leg. Depending on the market, this may be `Yes`, `No`, `Up`, `Down`, or a named outcome.

outcomePrice.description: Leg outcome price at the time of the trade, on a 0 to 1 scale.

actionType.description: Action label for this combo fill.

comboPositionId.description: Combo position ID this fill belongs to.

size.description: Number of combo shares in this fill.

price.description: Price per combo share as a decimal from 0 to 1. Multiply by 100 to get cents.

fee.description: Fee charged for this fill, in USDC.

legs.description: The underlying market outcomes that make up this combo position.

traderAddress.description: The primary wallet this transaction is attributed to.

sourceType.description: How the transaction was categorized. `TRADE` is a regular order fill. `COMBO` is a combo (parlay) trade.

actionType.description: Top-level action for the transaction (the trade direction, e.g. `Buy` or `Sell`).

sentence.example: Buy 3604.58 No for $3546.12269 in Will Bitcoin dip to $59,000 on June 9?

marketSlug.description: Market slug. `null` for combo transactions, where the trade spans several markets.

marketId.description: Market ID. `null` for combo transactions, where the trade spans several markets.

actions.description: Every individual on-chain fill contained in this transaction. `null` for combo transactions, which report their fills in `comboActions` instead.

comboActions.description: Combo (parlay) fills contained in this transaction, one per trader. `null` for regular trades, whose fills appear in `actions` instead.

positionSide.description: Position side. Varies by market — e.g. `Yes` / `No` for binary markets, `Up` / `Down` for price direction markets.

percentPnl.description: PnL as a percentage of cost basis.

recentTradeTime.description: Most recent trade timestamp (Unix seconds) for this position — set for both open and closed positions.

outcome.description: Outcome label. Varies by market — e.g. `Yes` / `No`, or an outcome name for named markets.

resolved.description: Whether the leg market is resolved.

percentPnl.description: PnL as a percentage of cost basis.

positionValue.description: Total mark-to-market value of all open positions in USDC.

usdBalance.description: Uninvested USDC balance in the wallet.
